name: Air Force Aerial Achievement Medal (miniature medal body)
size_basis: Raster proportion: the ribbon in images/mini_medals/mcchord/m_usaf_aam01.webp is 0.625 in wide (ribbon measured 50 px in the source raster) (miniature 5/8 in; coordination chat citing DoDM 1348.33; CAPR 39-3 gives no medal dimensions); the medal body is measured at 50 x 53 source px = 0.625 x 0.662 in at that scale. Width kept from the previous asset; the product photo shows the medal disc and suspension ring, height now 0.7583 in (was 0.6625).

ribbon_ref.note: medal body only; the ribbon asset supplies the stripes and devices. ribbon_attach is where the ribbon meets the suspension loop.

source: https://vanguardmil.com/products/usaf-aerial-achievement-full-size-medal; vendor product photograph (Vanguard Military Products), used only as a measurement reference; licence not stated by the vendor

fit.metric: silhouette IoU vs photo foreground mask at working resolution
fit.note: Posterised to 5 flat sampled tones (smoothed, Chaikin + RDP, specks dropped); 4 nested tone layers over the traced silhouette.
